basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming two-bedroom Victorian condo in a two-unit  building with lovely period detailing! This full flat unit is situated on a corner  lot and has wonderful light throughout. In the front of the unit is living room  with a decorative fireplace which is adjacent to the formal dining room,  which could easily be used as a home office or additional bedroom. In  addition, there are two bedrooms which have lots of natural light, a kitchen,  bathroom and a rear laundry room. There are hardwood floors, high  ceilings and period detailing throughout plus nice views from the rear of the  unit. Downstairs is a very large, deeded storage area. Super Glen Park  location with great freeway access and within walking distance to Bart and  Glen Park Village! This wonderful unit is a must see and a terrific value!
